checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: a shiny Voltorb in Route 10's grass by the wild RNG, stored in the PC, back to the nurse

events.why: The catch's summary needs a party slot. The PC refuses a member holding Mail, so this stores the one that holds none (on the Sevii save the other five hold the mail glitch's Mail).
Into the north grass, where Sweet Scent finds Voltorb, Spearow and Ekans.
The wild RNG's hard reset boots from this save, in the grass.

A shiny Voltorb, the soonest of the table for the run's TID and SID (passed via --options, GAMEPILOT_FRLG_TID/SID, or trainer_ids.json). seed_shift 8: what this checkpoint's grass save (the save file's save number 139) adds to the table's seeds on mGBA, measured from it. The party's last member knows Sweet Scent. ingame_offset -1: the target's waits otherwise land on another advance, measured by replaying the presses on the grass save with an RNG trace.
Stores the catch, so the party is five again with the Sweet Scent member last, as the next catch needs.
Sweet Scent's PP back at the nurse.
Outdoors, where the next catch starts.

metadata.notes: mGBA only. The seed shift holds for this checkpoint's start save as the program's chain leaves it (from sevii_story's end, two saves a catch): a start save with another number of saves before it boots a few timer counts off and misses, failing the checkpoint (wild_rng_not_shiny) with the catch unsaved. Starts with the Sevii story's full party; make_room leaves five, with the Sweet Scent member last.
